    41	/// If an instruction is trivialized (dead), then the chain of users of that

    44	static void clearAssumptionsOfUsers(Instruction *I, DemandedBits &DB) {

    46	         "Trivializing a non-integer value?");

    48	  // Initialize the worklist with eligible direct users.
    49	  SmallPtrSet<Instruction *, 16> Visited;
    50	  SmallVector<Instruction *, 16> WorkList;

    54	    auto *J = dyn_cast<Instruction>(JU);

    64	    // will demand its input bits). However, if we have a readnone function
    65	    // that returns an unsized type (e.g., void), we must avoid asking for the

APInt DemandedBits::getDemandedBits(Instruction *I) {
  performAnalysis();

  auto Found = AliveBits.find(I);
  if (Found != AliveBits.end())
    return Found->second;

  const DataLayout &DL = I->getModule()->getDataLayout();
  return APInt::getAllOnes(DL.getTypeSizeInBits(I->getType()->getScalarType()));
}

APInt DemandedBits::getDemandedBits(Use *U) {
  Type *T = (*U)->getType();
  auto *UserI = cast<Instruction>(U->getUser());
  const DataLayout &DL = UserI->getModule()->getDataLayout();
  unsigned BitWidth = DL.getTypeSizeInBits(T->getScalarType());

messages.reasoning_content:
These are the tests from the patch (upstream test file exists in the repo). Note the interesting test `select_of_and_different_demanded` where `%and1 = and i64 0, 24` — hmm, that's the result of the transform: `%and1 = and i64 %a, 24` was simplified to `%a`, then `%a` demanded bits... Actually the CHECK shows `[[AND1:%.*]] = and i64 0, 24` meaning `%a` was replaced by 0? Interesting: `%a` is an argument; BDCE trivializes dead uses to 0.

static APInt determineLiveOperandBitsAddCarry(unsigned OperandNo,
                                              const APInt &AOut,
                                              const KnownBits &LHS,
                                              const KnownBits &RHS,
                                              bool CarryZero, bool CarryOne) {
  assert(!(CarryZero && CarryOne) &&
         "Carry can't be zero and one at the same time");

  // The following check should be done by the caller, as it also indicates
  // that LHS and RHS don't need to be computed.
  //
  // if (AOut.isMask())
  //   return AOut;

  // Boundary bits' carry out is unaffected by their carry in.
  APInt Bound = (LHS.Zero & RHS.Zero) | (LHS.One & RHS.One);

  // First, the alive carry bits are determined from the alive output bits:
  // Let demand ripple to the right but only up to any set bit in Bound.
  //   AOut         = -1----
  //   Bound        = ----1-
  //   ACarry&~AOut = --111-
  APInt RBound = Bound.reverseBits();
  APInt RAOut = AOut.reverseBits();
  APInt RProp = RAOut + (RAOut | ~RBound);
  APInt RACarry = RProp ^ ~RBound;
  APInt ACarry = RACarry.reverseBits();

  // Then, the alive input bits are determined from the alive carry bits:
  APInt NeededToMaintainCarryZero;
  APInt NeededToMaintainCarryOne;
  if (OperandNo == 0) {
    NeededToMaintainCarryZero = LHS.Zero | ~RHS.Zero;
    NeededToMaintainCarryOne = LHS.One | ~RHS.One;
  } else {
    NeededToMaintainCarryZero = RHS.Zero | ~LHS.Zero;
    NeededToMaintainCarryOne = RHS.One | ~LHS.One;
  }

  // As in computeForAddCarry
  APInt PossibleSumZero = ~LHS.Zero + ~RHS.Zero + !CarryZero;
  APInt PossibleSumOne = LHS.One + RHS.One + CarryOne;

  // The below is simplified from
  //
  // APInt CarryKnownZero = ~(PossibleSumZero ^ LHS.Zero ^ RHS.Zero);
  // APInt CarryKnownOne = PossibleSumOne ^ LHS.One ^ RHS.One;
  // APInt CarryUnknown = ~(CarryKnownZero | CarryKnownOne);
  //
  // APInt NeededToMaintainCarry =
  //   (CarryKnownZero & NeededToMaintainCarryZero) |
  //   (CarryKnownOne  & NeededToMaintainCarryOne) |
  //   CarryUnknown;

  APInt NeededToMaintainCarry = (~PossibleSumZero | NeededToMaintainCarryZero) &
                                (PossibleSumOne | NeededToMaintainCarryOne);

  APInt AB = AOut | (ACarry & NeededToMaintainCarry);
  return AB;
}

APInt DemandedBits::determineLiveOperandBitsAdd(unsigned OperandNo,
                                                const APInt &AOut,
                                                const KnownBits &LHS,
                                                const KnownBits &RHS) {
  return determineLiveOperandBitsAddCarry(OperandNo, AOut, LHS, RHS, true,
                                          false);
}

APInt DemandedBits::determineLiveOperandBitsSub(unsigned OperandNo,
                                                const APInt &AOut,
                                                const KnownBits &LHS,
                                                const KnownBits &RHS) {
  KnownBits NRHS;
  NRHS.Zero = RHS.One;
  NRHS.One = RHS.Zero;
  return determineLiveOperandBitsAddCarry(OperandNo, AOut, LHS, NRHS, false,
                                          true);
}

      const unsigned EffWidthX = XKnown.countMaxActiveBits();

  // Propagate liveness backwards to operands.
  while (!Worklist.empty()) {
    Instruction *UserI = Worklist.pop_back_val();

    LLVM_DEBUG(dbgs() << "DemandedBits: Visiting: " << *UserI);
    APInt AOut;
    bool InputIsKnownDead = false;
    if (UserI->getType()->isIntOrIntVectorTy()) {
      AOut = AliveBits[UserI];
      LLVM_DEBUG(dbgs() << " Alive Out: 0x"
                        << Twine::utohexstr(AOut.getLimitedValue()));

      // If all bits of the output are dead, then all bits of the input
      // are also dead.
      InputIsKnownDead = !AOut && !isAlwaysLive(UserI);
    }
    LLVM_DEBUG(dbgs() << "\n");

    KnownBits Known, Known2;
    bool KnownBitsComputed = false;
    // Compute the set of alive bits for each operand. These are anded into the
    // existing set, if any, and if that changes the set of alive bits, the
    // operand is added to the work-list.
    for (Use &OI : UserI->operands()) {
      // We also want to detect dead uses of arguments, but will only store
      // demanded bits for instructions.
      auto *I = dyn_cast<Instruction>(OI);
      if (!I && !isa<Argument>(OI))
        continue;

      Type *T = OI->getType();
      if (T->isIntOrIntVectorTy()) {
        unsigned BitWidth = T->getScalarSizeInBits();
        APInt AB = APInt::getAllOnes(BitWidth);
        if (InputIsKnownDead) {
          AB = APInt(BitWidth, 0);
        } else {
          // Bits of each operand that are used to compute alive bits of the
          // output are alive, all others are dead.
          determineLiveOperandBits(UserI, OI, OI.getOperandNo(), AOut, AB,
                                   Known, Known2, KnownBitsComputed);

          // Keep track of uses which have no demanded bits.
          if (AB.isZero())
            DeadUses.insert(&OI);
          else
            DeadUses.erase(&OI);
        }

        if (I) {
          // If we've added to the set of alive bits (or the operand has not
          // been previously visited), then re-queue the operand to be visited
          // again.
          auto Res = AliveBits.try_emplace(I);
          if (Res.second || (AB |= Res.first->second) != Res.first->second) {
            Res.first->second = std::move(AB);
            Worklist.insert(I);
          }
        }
      } else if (I && Visited.insert(I).second) {
        Worklist.insert(I);
      }
    }
  }

```llvm
%y = or i8 %z, 0x80          ; mask 0x80
%a = add nuw i8 %y, %w       ; %a used by a call → demanded(%a) = all ones
```
demanded(%y) = AOut(all ones) | ... = all ones → no transform. Hmm, for add, demanded(op) ⊇ AOut = all ones → all ones. So no transform.

import re, sys

def parse(path):
    """Parse a simple straight-line function; return (params, [(op, args, dst)]) and sinks."""
    txt = open(path).read()
    m = re.search(r"define \w+ @f\(([^)]*)\) \{(.*?)\n\}", txt, re.S)
    params = []
    for p in m.group(1).split(","):
        p = p.strip()
        if not p: continue
        ty, name = p.rsplit(" ", 1)
        params.append((name.strip(), ty.strip()))
    stmts = []
    for line in m.group(2).split("\n"):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        stmts.append(line)
    return params, stmts

def val(tok, env, W):
    tok = tok.strip()
    if tok.startswith("%"):
        return env[tok]
    if tok.startswith("<"):
        mm = re.match(r"<i(\d+) (-?\d+), i\d+ (-?\d+)>", tok)
        raise Exception("vector unsupported: " + tok)
    v = int(tok)
    return v & ((1 << W) - 1)

def eval_prog(params, stmts, inputs, usecalls):
    env = {}
    for (name, ty), v in zip(params, inputs):
        env[name] = v
    for s in stmts:
        if s.startswith("call void @use"):
            arg = re.match(r"call void @use\w*\(i(\d+) (%\S+|\d+)\)", s)
            w = int(arg.group(1)); v = int(arg.group(2)) if not arg.group(2).startswith("%") else env[arg.group(2)]
            usecalls.append((w, v))
            continue
        if s.startswith("ret") or s.startswith("store") or s.startswith("br") or s.startswith("entry") or s.startswith("call void @llvm.assume"):
            continue
        mm = re.match(r"(%\S+) = (\S+) (\S+) (.*)", s)
        if not mm:
            raise Exception("unparsed stmt: " + s)
        dst, op, ty, rest = mm.group(1), mm.group(2), mm.group(3), mm.group(4)
        if ty.startswith("i"):
            W = int(re.match(r"i(\d+)", ty).group(1))
        else:
            raise Exception("unsupported type " + ty)
        if op == "select":
            cond = rest.split(",")[0].strip()
            cv = int(cond.split()[-1]) if not cond.split()[-1].startswith("%") else env[cond.split()[-1]]
            a, b = rest.split(",")[1], rest.split(",")[2]

{"command": "cat > /tmp/w/dt.py <<'PYEOF'
import re, sys, subprocess, itertools, random

W = 8
MASK = (1 << W) - 1

def parse_func(path):
    txt = open(path).read()
    m = re.search(r"define void @f\(([^)]*)\) \{(.*?)\n\}", txt, re.S)
    assert m, path
    params = []
    for p in m.group(1).split(","):
        p = p.strip()
        if not p: continue
        ty, name = p.rsplit(" ", 1)
        assert ty == "i8", ty
        params.append(name.strip())
    stmts = []
    for line in m.group(2).split("\n"):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("attributes") or line.startswith(";"):
            continue
        stmts.append(line)
    return params, stmts

def getval(tok, env):
    tok = tok.strip()
    if tok.startswith("%"):
        return env[tok]
    return int(tok) & MASK

def eval_stmts(params, stmts, inputs):
    env = dict(zip(params, inputs))
    uses = []
    for s in stmts:
        m = re.match(r"call void @use\(i8 (%\S+|\d+)\)$", s)
        if m:
            uses.append(getval(m.group(1), env)); continue
        if s == "ret void":
            continue
        m = re.match(r"(%\S+) = (.*)$", s)
        assert m, s
        dst, rhs = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        m2 = re.match(r"(and|or|xor|add|sub|mul|shl|lshr|ashr)(?: \w+)* i8 (%\S+|\d+), (%\S+|\d+)$", rhs)
        if m2:
            op, a, b = m2.group(1), getval(m2.group(2), env), getval(m2.group(3), env)
            if op == "and": v = a & b
            elif op == "or": v = a | b
            elif op == "xor": v = a ^ b
            elif op == "add": v = (a + b) & MASK

import re, sys, subprocess, itertools, random

W = 8
MASK = 255

def getval(tok, env):
    tok = tok.strip()
    if tok.startswith("%"):
        return env[tok]
    return int(tok) & MASK

def eval_stmts(params, stmts, inputs):
    env = dict(zip(params, inputs))
    uses = []
    for s in stmts:
        m = re.match(r"call void @use\(i8 (%\S+|-?\d+)\)$", s)
        if m:
            uses.append(getval(m.group(1), env)); continue
        if s == "ret void":
            continue
        m = re.match(r"(%\S+) = (.*)$", s)
        assert m, s
        dst, rhs = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        m2 = re.match(r"(and|or|xor|add|sub|mul|shl|lshr|ashr)(?: \w+)* i8 (%\S+|-?\d+), (%\S+|-?\d+)$", rhs)
        if m2:
            op, a, b = m2.group(1), getval(m2.group(2), env), getval(m2.group(3), env)
            if op == "and": v = a & b
            elif op == "or": v = a | b
            elif op == "xor": v = a ^ b
            elif op == "add": v = (a + b) & MASK
            elif op == "sub": v = (a - b) & MASK
            elif op == "mul": v = (a * b) & MASK
            elif op == "shl": v = (a << b) & MASK if b < 8 else None
            elif op == "lshr": v = (a >> b) if b < 8 else None
            elif op == "ashr":
                sa = a - 256 if a >= 128 else a
                v = ((sa >> b) & MASK) if b < 8 else None
            env[dst] = v
            continue
        m2 = re.match(r"call i8 @llvm\.(cttz|ctlz)\.i8\(i8 (%\S+|-?\d+), i1 (?:false|true)\)$", rhs)
        if m2:
            fn, a = m2.group(1), getval(m2.group(2), env)
            v = 8 if a == 0 else ((a & -a).bit_length() - 1) if fn == "cttz" else (8 - a.bit_length())
            env[dst] = v
            continue
        m2 = re.match(r"select i1 (%\S+|-?\d+), i8 (%\S+|-?\d+), i8 (%\S+|-?\d+)$", rhs)
        if m2:
            c = getval(m2.group(1), env)
            env[dst] = getval(m2.group(2), env) if c else getval(m2.group(3), env)
            continue
        m2 = re.match(r"icmp (\w+) i8 (%\S+|-?\d+), (%\S+|-?\d+)$", rhs)
        if m2:
            pred, a, b = m2.group(1), getval(m2.group(2), env), getval(m2.group(3), env)
            sa = a - 256 if a >= 128 else a
            sb = b - 256 if b >= 128 else b
            v = {"eq": a == b, "ne": a != b, "ult": a < b, "ugt": a > b, "ule": a <= b, "uge": a >= b,
                 "slt": sa < sb, "sgt": sa > sb, "sle": sa <= sb, "sge": sa >= sb}[pred]
            env[dst] = 1 if v else 0
            continue
        raise Exception("unparsed: " + s)
    return tuple(uses)

def parse_module(path):
    txt = open(path).read()
    fns = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r"define void @(f\d+)\(([^)]*)\) \{(.*?)\n\}", txt, re.S):
        params = [p.strip().split(" ")[-1] for p in m.group(2).split(",") if p.strip()]
        stmts = [l.strip() for l in m.group(3).split("\n") if l.strip()]
        fns[m.group(1)] = (params, stmts)
    return fns

def check_module(srcpath, tgtpath, names):
    src_fns = parse_module(srcpath)
    tgt_fns = parse_module(tgtpath)
    bad = []
    cache = {}
    for n in names:
        if n not in src_fns or n not in tgt_fns:
            continue
        for fns, tag in ((src_fns, "src"), (tgt_fns, "tgt")):
            params, stmts = fns[n]
            key = (tag, n)
            res = []
            try:
                for inputs in itertools.product(range(256), repeat=len(params)):
                    res.append(eval_stmts(params, stmts, inputs))
            except Exception as e:
                return [("EVALERR", n, tag, str(e), src_fns[n])]
            cache[key] = tuple(res)
        if cache[("src", n)] != cache[("tgt", n)]:
            bad.append(n)
    return bad

W = 8
MASK = 255

def getval(tok, env):

    if tok.startswith("%"):

    env = dict(zip(params, inputs))
    uses = []
    for s in stmts:
        m = re.match(r"call void @use\(i8 (%\S+|-?\d+)\)$", s)

        if s == "ret void":

            elif op == "xor": v = a ^ b

            elif op == "lshr": v = (a >> b) if b < 8 else None
            elif op == "ashr":

        m2 = re.match(r"call i8 @llvm\.(cttz|ctlz)\.i8\(i8 (%\S+|-?\d+), i1 (?:false|true)\)$", rhs)

            p, s = tgt_fns[n]; print("--- TGT ---\ndefine void @%s(i8 %s) {\n  %s\n}" % (n, " ".join(p), "\n  ".join(s)))

{"command": "cat > /tmp/w/dt4.py <<'PYEOF'
import re, sys, subprocess, itertools, random

W = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 4
MASK = (1 << W) - 1
TY = "i%d" % W

def getval(tok, env):
    tok = tok.strip()
    if tok.startswith("%"):
        return env[tok]
    return int(tok) & MASK

def ev(s, env, uses):
    m = re.match(r"call void @use\(" + TY + r" (%\S+|-?\d+)\)$", s)
    if m:
        uses.append(getval(m.group(1), env)); return
    if s == "ret void":
        return
    m = re.match(r"(%\S+) = (.*)$", s)
    assert m, s
    dst, rhs = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    m2 = re.match(r"(and|or|xor|add|sub|mul|udiv|sdiv)(?: \w+)* " + TY + r" (%\S+|-?\d+), (%\S+|-?\d+)$", rhs)
    if m2:
        op, a, b = m2.group(1), getval(m2.group(2), env), getval(m2.group(3), env)
        sa = a - (1 << W) if a >> (W - 1) else a
        sb = b - (1 << W) if b >> (W - 1) else b
        v = {"and": a & b, "or": a | b, "xor": a ^ b, "add": (a + b) & MASK, "sub": (a - b) & MASK,
             "mul": (a * b) & MASK, "udiv": (a // b) & MASK if b else None,
             "sdiv": (int(sa / sb) if sb and abs(sa / sb) < (1 << W) else None) & MASK if b else None}[op]
        env[dst] = v

def parse_module(path):
    txt = open(path).read()

    out = []
    for inputs in itertools.product(range(1 << W), repeat=len(params)):
        out.append(eval_fn(params, stmts, inputs))

OPS2 = ["and","or","xor","add","sub","mul","shl","lshr","ashr","ctlz","cttz"]

    hdr = "declare void @use(%s)\ndeclare %s @llvm.cttz.%s(%s, i1)\ndeclare %s @llvm.ctlz.%s(%s, i1)\n" % (TY, TY, TY, TY, TY, TY, TY)

    names = []

        n = "f%d" % i
        names.append(n)
        shape = rng.randrange(0, 4)
        opY = rng.choice(BIN); My = rng.choice(MASKS)
        opO = rng.choice(OPS2); Mr = rng.choice(MASKS)
        C = rng.randrange(0, W) if opO in ("shl","lshr","ashr") else rng.choice(MASKS)
        st = []
        st.append("  %%v0 = %s %s %%p0, %d" % (opY, TY, My))
        if shape == 0:
            if opO in ("ctlz","cttz"):
                st.append("  %%v1 = call %s @llvm.%s.%s(%s %%v0, i1 false)" % (TY, opO, TY, TY))
            else:
                st.append("  %%v1 = %s %s %%v0, %d" % (opO, TY, C))
            st.append("  %%v2 = and %s %%v1, %d" % (TY, Mr))
            st.append("  call void @use(%s %v2)" % TY)
            np = 1
        elif shape == 1:
            opW = rng.choice(BIN); Mw = rng.choice(MASKS)
            st.append("  %%v1 = %s %s %%p1, %d" % (opW, TY, Mw))
            if opO in ("ctlz","cttz"):
                st.append("  %%v2 = call %s @llvm.%s.%s(%s %%v0, i1 false)" % (TY, opO, TY, TY))
            elif opO in ("shl","lshr","ashr"):
                st.append("  %%v2 = %s %s %%v0, %d" % (opO, TY, rng.randrange(0, W)))
            else:
                st.append("  %%v2 = %s %s %%v0, %%v1" % (opO, TY))
            st.append("  %%v3 = and %s %%v2, %d" % (TY, Mr))
            st.append("  call void @use(%s %v3)" % TY)
            np = 2
        elif shape == 2:
            opR = rng.choice(["and","lshr","shl","ashr","mul","or","xor"])
            R2 = rng.randrange(0, W) if opR in ("shl","lshr","ashr") else rng.choice(MASKS)
            if opO in ("ctlz","cttz"):
                st.append("  %%v1 = call %s @llvm.%s.%s(%s %%v0, i1 false)" % (TY, opO, TY, TY))
            else:
                st.append("  %%v1 = %s %s %%v0, %d" % (opO, TY, C))
            st.append("  %%v2 = %s %s %%v1, %d" % (opR, TY, R2))
            st.append("  %%v3 = and %s %%v2, %d" % (TY, Mr))
            st.append("  call void @use(%s %v3)" % TY)
            np = 1
        else:
            # multi-use: v0 used by two users
            opO2 = rng.choice(OPS2); C2 = rng.randrange(0, W) if opO2 in ("shl","lshr","ashr") else rng.choice(MASKS)
            Mr2 = rng.choice(MASKS)
            st.append("  %%v1 = %s %s %%v0, %d" % (opO, TY, C))
            st.append("  %%v2 = and %s %%v1, %d" % (TY, Mr))
            st.append("  %%v3 = %s %s %%v0, %d" % (opO2, TY, C2))
            st.append("  %%v4 = and %s %%v3, %d" % (TY, Mr2))
            st.append("  call void @use(%s %v2)" % TY)
            st.append("  call void @use(%s %v4)" % TY)
            np = 1
        pl = ", ".join("%s %%p%d" % (TY, k) for k in range(np))
        body += "define void @%s(%s) {\n%s\n  ret void\n}\n" % (n, pl, "\n".join(st))

    for b in range(batches):
        rng = random.Random(seed0 + b * 104729)
        ir, names = build(rng, per)
        open("/tmp/w/m.ll", "w").write(ir)
        r = subprocess.run(["opt", "-S", "-passes=bdce", "/tmp/w/m.ll", "-o", "/tmp/w/m.out.ll"],

        if r.returncode != 0:

            sp, ss = src_fns[n]; tp, ts = tgt_fns[n]
            rs = run_fn(sp, ss); rt = run_fn(tp, ts)
            if rs != rt:
                print("=== BATCH %d fn %s MISCOMPILE ===" % (b, n))
                print("define void @f(%s) {\n  %s\n}" % (", ".join(sp), "\n  ".join(ss)))
                print("--- tgt ---")
                print("define void @f(%s) {\n  %s\n}" % (", ".join(tp), "\n  ".join(ts)))
                for i, (a, bb) in enumerate(zip(rs, rt)):
                    if a != bb:
                        print("inputs", list(itertools.product(range(1 << W), repeat=len(sp)))[i], a, bb); break
                found = True
                break
        if found: return
        sys.stderr.write(".")
    print("\ndone")

```cpp
bool DemandedBits::isUseDead(Use *U) {
  if (!(*U)->getType()->isIntOrIntVectorTy()) return false;
  auto *UserI = cast<Instruction>(U->getUser());
  if (isAlwaysLive(UserI)) return false;
  performAnalysis();
  if (DeadUses.count(U)) return true;
  if (UserI->getType()->isIntOrIntVectorTy()) {
    auto Found = AliveBits.find(UserI);
    if (Found != AliveBits.end() && Found->second.isZero()) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
```
